body: Wire agb handoff, agb gate-ticket --skip-browser --browser-url, agb plan --delta, and agb init --automations in bin/agb.mjs, and register lib/browser-gate.mjs, lib/handoff.mjs, and handoff in scripts/release-audit-collect.mjs. Author commands/agb-handoff.md and skills/agb-handoff/SKILL.md, update commands/agb.md and skills/agb/SKILL.md, and update skill/command inventories in test/commands.test.mjs, test/plugin-layout.test.mjs, and test/skills-cross-harness.test.mjs. Add AGB_BROWSER_CHECK_CMD to website/env-docs.json, create website/content/docs/reference/cli/handoff.mdx, register handoff in website/content/docs/reference/cli/meta.json and website/scripts/ia.json, regenerate website/generated/*, verify node website/scripts/check-all.mjs, and rebuild dist/**. Verify: npm run build && node website/scripts/gen-reference.mjs --check && node website/scripts/check-all.mjs && npm run skills:check && node --test test/commands.test.mjs test/plugin-layout.test.mjs test/skills-cross-harness.test.mjs
title: CLI Wiring, /agb-handoff Skill & Command, Website Docs & Bundles
